seconds.note: per annotation, heavy-tailed (a task left open inflates the mean); use median/IQR. Pilot annotations are not in the specified tables: chưa đo

labels_by_group_note: bu_* = Wilson 95% for blocked/usable; ba_* = Wilson for blocked/all crops; bu_cluster_* = street-cluster bootstrap (B=1000); main_val has 3 streets, main_test 4, pilot 3: cluster interval is only indicative; extra_* are selected by a model score, not natural
train_composition_note: Wilson intervals treat crops as independent; the composition is not a natural sample for T3-T6 (extra selected by model score)
obstacle_tags_note: Multi-label: shares do not sum to 1. Main double-labelled items: a tag counts once per item if ANY annotator who labelled it 1 chose it. Pilot: chưa đo (no per-annotation table with tags among the specified inputs).
annotator_note: Main annotations: each annotator labels a different mix (test: Học+Loan, val: Minh+Khải, train: all 5), so shares per annotator over all roles are confounded by split; role=train_single and train_extra are randomly assigned. train_extra labels are the v1 labels (before cross-check).
vif_note: travel_bearing is circular (0-360), entered raw as in the Spearman matrix; lat/lon/street are structurally linked (crops lie along streets). VIF > 5 would indicate multicollinearity.
assoc_note: Crops are clustered by street: iid p-values (p_*_optimistic) are too small; use effect sizes and the street-cluster bootstrap intervals (B=1000, resampling streets with replacement). 'reading' is a heuristic: CI of AUC contains 0.5 -> no separation; |2AUC-1|<0.10 -> weak; else signal. Metadata are not model inputs. main_all pools val/test and is descriptive only; main_train is the train-only view.

pilot_to_main_distance_m.note: pilot_v2 has no position_group; distance to nearest main crop of the same street is the only proxy (not the 25 m position key)

dist_to_street_m.note: max and count at max/0.0 as computed; no interpretation (cause of 0.0 / 20.0 not checked against docs)
